subject: general
question: Which among the following novels was written by famous Indian author Mulk Raj Anand?
solution:
The correct answer is Untouchable

 
• Mulk Raj Anand wrote the novel "Untouchable".
 
• The novel is about the life of a young boy named Bakha who is an "untouchable" in Indian society.
 
• Anand was a prominent figure in the Indian literary scene and was known for his social commentary and criticism of the caste system.
 
• "Train to Pakistan" was written by Khushwant Singh and is about the Partition of India in 1947.
 
• The Room on the Roof is a novel written by Ruskin Bond.
 
• "Godan" was written by Munshi Premchand and is about a poor farmer's struggle to buy a cow.
